• 19-11-2026 Public hearing on 26-11-2026: buses from Chatkal and Talas
    Company buses will take residents to the hearing on the Chatkal mercury recovery unit at the Rudnik house of culture: from the Chatkal works settlement at 15:00 and from Talas (Metallurgy Avenue) at 14:00, returning after the hearing.

• 27-11-2026 Public hearing held at Rudnik
    Residents of Rudnik and the Chatkal works settlement, the Chatkal Placer Mining Inspectorate and the Sary-Bulak district administration attended. Written comments are accepted until 10-12-2026 at the house of culture, the Chatkal works office or by e-mail to info@iarmc.com. The record of the hearing will be published with the answers to the comments.

• 11-12-2026 Comments on the mercury recovery unit closed
    The period for written comments closed on 10-12-2026. The comments and the Combine's answers will be sent to the Ministry of Natural Resources with the permit application. The unit stays idle until a permit is issued.

• 21-12-2026 Working schedule over the holidays
    The mine and the furnaces work continuously over Christmas and the New Year. The head office in Talas is closed on 25-12-2026, 28-12-2026 and 01-01-2027. Company buses run to the Sunday timetable on those days.

• 17-02-2027 Fifteen years since the rockfall at Shaft No. 2
    The labour collective and the families laid flowers at the miners' memorial by the Shaft No. 1 headframe in memory of the four miners who died in the old stopes of Shaft No. 2 in February 2012.

• 04-03-2027 Trust line: reports for 2026
    The Compliance Officer has given the Audit Commission the summary of reports received through the trust line in 2026. Reports can be made in confidence by telephone, by e-mail or in the boxes at the shaft heads and the Chatkal gate.

• 05-04-2027 Restart Programme: vacancies at the flotation section and trioxide shop No. 2
    Recruitment continues for the first stage of the Restart Programme. Applicants from the Talas and Sary-Bulak districts have priority; hostel places are available. See Vacancies.

• 21-05-2027 Notice of the Annual General Meeting of shareholders
    The Annual General Meeting will be held on 18-06-2027 at 10:00 in Talas. On the agenda: the Annual Report and accounts for 2026, the election of the Supervisory Board and the Audit Commission. Shareholders on the register at 21-05-2027 may attend; papers from the Shares Department.

• 11-06-2027 Graduation at the Chatkal technical lyceum
    A new class of metallurgical technicians has completed its studies. Graduates offered posts at the Combine start after the summer.

• 18-06-2027 Annual General Meeting of shareholders
    The Annual General Meeting was held in Talas. Shareholders approved the Annual Report and accounts for 2026 and elected the Supervisory Board and the Audit Commission for one year.

• 29-08-2027 Miners' Day at Rudnik
    The labour collective laid wreaths at the miners' memorial by the Shaft No. 1 headframe, followed by a concert at the house of culture and the ulak match of the Sary-Bulak district team.

• 10-09-2027 New season at the Kombinat Stadium
    The Combine continues its sponsorship of Surma Chatkal and of youth football in the Chatkal works settlement.

• 20-10-2027 Company buses: winter timetable from 01-11-2027
    From 1 November the company buses to Sary-Bulak and Chatkal leave 15 minutes earlier on the mountain sections. The timetable is posted at the bus stops and the shaft heads.
